description_expanded: Summary.css-10xdy1o{font-size:var(--chakra-fontSizes-md);color:var(--chakra-colors-primary-600);margin-top:var(--chakra-space-1);}Welcome to “Sea Esta 30A”, conveniently located on scenic Highway 30A right across from the beach! This newly updated condo is perfectly located in the heart of Seagrove, with access to the famous Emerald beaches and Café 30a just steps away!! This home has everything you could want or need for your next beach vacation - Come pamper yourselves – you deserve to be spoiled!.css-1ji0eah{margin-top:var(--chakra-space-8);position:relative;}.css-1q2slen{max-height:100px;overflow:hidden;position:relative;}.css-brfu0{font-size:1.2rem;line-height:1.8;white-space:pre-line;}.css-6qgo7l{display:-webkit-box;display:-webkit-flex;display:-ms-flexbox;display:flex;-webkit-align-items:flex-start;-webkit-box-align:flex-start;-ms-flex-align:flex-start;align-items:flex-start;-webkit-flex-direction:column;-ms-flex-direction:column;flex-direction:column;margin-bottom:var(--chakra-space-12);}.css-16qsgd1{line-height:1.2;letter-spacing:-0.025em;font-size:var(--chakra-fontSizes-xl);font-weight:400;font-family:var(--chakra-fonts-body);color:var(--chakra-colors-primary-800);}Space.css-1wz6mgq{opacity:0.6;border:0;border-style:solid;border-bottom-width:1px;width:100%;border-color:var(--chakra-colors-gray-200);}.css-1wz6mgq{margin-top:0.5rem;margin-bottom:0.5rem;-webkit-margin-start:0px;margin-inline-start:0px;-webkit-margin-end:0px;margin-inline-end:0px;border-left-width:0;border-bottom-width:1px;}.css-5ww9bs{font-size:var(--chakra-fontSizes-md);margin-top:var(--chakra-space-3);color:var(--chakra-colors-primary-600);}This professionally decorated condominium, with new interior paint, windows and shiplap, has been designed with your comfort in mind. It sleeps 4 comfortably, featuring a luxury queen-sized bed in the private bedroom, built-in twin bunk beds and queen sleeper sofa, making this a perfect place for a weekend with friends, couples get away or family vacation. HELPFUL NEIGHBORHOOD INFORMATION - Located on the north side of 30A - Easy walking distance to our infamous Emerald Coast beach (5 minutes) - 2 Swimming pools (1 is heated in March) - Lighted tennis courts - Shuffleboard courts - Clubhouse - Community grills and picnic tables - On site laundry - Walking distance to Tom Thumb, short distance to Publix - Walking distance to some local shops and restaurants - 1.5 miles to Seaside BEACH ACCESS - Public access is an easy 5 minute walk from this property (beach chairs and wagon are included). - Beach set ups (2 chairs/umbrella) are available through South Walton Beach Guys. SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 4) - PRIMARY SUITE Queen-sized bed - BUNK NOOK (living room) 2 Twin sized bunks FEATURES - New interior paint, shiplap and windows - Professionally decorated - Full kitchen with stainless appliances - Walkable to beach, Timpoochee trail, shopping and restaurants - Flat screen TV's in both living room and primary bedroom - 2 pools (one heated seasonally and at HOA's discretion Nov - April) - Tennis - Shuffleboard - Community grills, picnic tables - Free Wifi - Parking for 2 vehicles - Onsite coin operated laundry - Discount provided on pontoon rental or yacht charter Beach supplies, beach chairs and wagon are included – perfect for your getaway at "Sea Esta 30A"!NotesInformation on discounts for bike & pontoon rentals as well as yacht charters will be provided in the welcome email after booking. The clubhouse will be closed until May 1st due to construction. The laundry room will not be open between the hours of 8am-5pm until May 1st due to construction. The laundry room is still accessible outside of these hours.
